text: Hercules Forge compiler validates application specifications and deterministically generates source files and build fingerprints.
Forge release control verifies artifacts before publish and records rollback evidence for safe deployments.
The Hercules model plane registers model families, lifecycle state, checkpoints, runtimes, and native routing policy.
Hercules training requires dataset provenance, license rights, content hashes, training permission, source commits, and immutable evidence.
The Hercules agent router classifies instructions into code research vision speech and general orchestration intents.
The Hercules retrieval model creates native sparse text embeddings and reranks documents for memory and search.
Hercules Guard will enforce policy permissions secret handling and action validation before sensitive operations.
Hercules Coder will specialize in software engineering debugging repository changes testing and code generation.
Hercules Vision will understand screenshots images documents interface layouts and visual evidence.
Hercules Voice will support speech recognition transcription speech synthesis and spoken conversation.
Hercules Research will retrieve sources verify evidence synthesize findings and preserve citations.
Hercules Core will provide general reasoning instruction following planning and broad language capabilities.
The Hercules staging plane isolates deployment tests and benchmarks before production promotion.
Hercules observability tracks service health latency errors evidence and reliability objectives.
The provenance gate requires origin documentation license compatibility third party notices and AI assistance disclosure.
SauceApproved Commerce uses Shopify for storefront products collections checkout discounts and ecommerce operations.
Printify provides print on demand fulfillment for apparel products including hoodie variants and production shipping.
Organic traffic strategy uses search visibility useful content landing pages and conversion measurement before paid advertising.
GitHub Actions workflows run automated tests provenance checks training jobs and deployment validation on repository changes.
Checkpoint lineage ties a model artifact hash to the exact training job dataset fingerprints code commit and evaluation evidence.
Evaluation gates require measured thresholds to pass before a candidate model checkpoint can become active.
An embedded model runtime executes inside the Hercules service and is loaded only when its checkpoint hash is verified.
An HTTP model runtime calls an authorized model service through a bounded provider neutral adapter.
Runtime secrets such as control tokens must be injected through environment or secret management and never committed to source.
Safe rollback restores a prior verified release when a deployment check fails or production behavior regresses.
The dataset registry records source URI record count license rights basis training approval and SHA 256 content identity.
A training worker executes a declared job but cannot change canonical model identity dataset admission or activation policy.
SHA 256 artifact hashing gives immutable identity to generated bundles checkpoints evidence packages and datasets.
Native only production routing rejects external model origins unless migration policy is deliberately changed.
Authenticated control APIs require bearer tokens and use bounded request bodies with fail closed behavior.
Hercules memory search uses document representations ranking and retrieval to surface relevant stored knowledge.
Semantic style ranking compares query representations with document representations and orders the most relevant results first.
